open_blockers.detail: Owner has NO ADMIN RIGHTS. Xcode 26.3 + iOS SDK 26.2 present, but /Library/Developer/PrivateFrameworks/{CoreDevice,CoreSimulator}.framework are absent and only an admin can install them. xcodebuild refuses to start without CoreSimulator even for a device-only unsigned build, so NO iOS build of any kind is possible. The paid Developer Program does NOT work around this — TestFlight still needs an .ipa, which needs xcodebuild. FIX: an admin runs `sudo xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch` once; after that a FREE Apple ID / Personal Team suffices. Verified working without admin: Godot generates the full iOS Xcode project, device+sim xcframeworks, MoltenVK and PCK; stops only on missing app icons.
open_blockers.owner: user — needs someone with admin on this Mac

open_blockers.severity: blocking Phase 0's performance budget; no longer blocks Phase 1
open_blockers.detail: An arm64-v8a Android emulator (AVD wastemarch_p6a) now runs the real phone build and its determinism hash matches macOS and Linux. A physical phone is still needed for the Phase 0 budget gate — 60 fps, <=120 draw calls, <=250k tris, and thermal behaviour — none of which an emulator can answer. Whether it also closes the Phase 1 gate is an OPEN QUESTION FOR THE OWNER: the emulator is the same M4 Pro silicon as the macOS leg, so it proves the Android toolchain and ABI agree, not that a Qualcomm chip does. sim-core is pure integer, which is why that risk is small.

open_decisions.detail: 'Wastemarch' is a working title. Needs USPTO/EUIPO and app-store searches before any public listing.
